configurePresets.name: vixen-ninja
configurePresets.description: Ninja generator so CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER (sccache) is honored and dependency tracking is fine-grained. Embedded (/Z7) debug info is required for sccache to cache MSVC debug builds (separate-PDB /Zi is non-cacheable and causes C1041 under parallel cl.exe). gtest_discover_tests runs at test time (PRE_TEST), not build time, so the build never executes test exes. Requires an MSVC environment (run from a VS Developer prompt or after vcvars64.bat).

configurePresets.name: vixen-wsl
configurePresets.description: Native Linux/GCC build for WSL2. Ninja generator; auto-provisions the LunarG Vulkan SDK (glslc + headers) into ${sourceDir}/.vulkan-sdk on first configure (VIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_VULKAN defaults ON). Mesa-Dozen (Vulkan-over-D3D12 GPU) provisioning is OFF — it builds Mesa from source (slow) and is unneeded for the offscreen lavapipe tests, which use the system software rasterizer. Run lavapipe tests with VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json and VK_LAYER_PATH=${sourceDir}/.vulkan-sdk/<ver>/x86_64/share/vulkan/explicit_layer.d. binaryDir is worktree-local (../build-wsl), parallel to the Windows ../build-ninja.
